description: A use child containing a tree loop -- the loop's dispatch event carries the same absolute path its own start/end events use, namespaced under the use node like any other child effect (#483; this case previously recorded the child store's own unnamespaced prime.<loop> path as correct, per a now-superseded review finding on PR #472). The tree-dynamic half of this probe is a Rust test instead (electricity-vm/tests/use_effect.rs): a dynamic container's own meta.adapter also picks up the use-triggered real-adapter heuristic, which this harness's single-location known_divergence can't express alongside the root's own.
